Motion Studio · 11 November 2026 · User issue 7

Every game. Every tool.
One way back.

All seven top-level routes now share an operator navigation bar: All games, a clear current location and Switch view. Capture ownership blocks application departure until the operator stops and confirms release. The destination never starts a camera automatically.

Issue #63 · Ready-for-review PR · Baseline 2cea8d7033a8be02f4f9d7079ecc0e6ca676a6fa

What changed and why

  • One reusable component/CSS replaces inconsistent header link groups. Four games and both operator tools remain available at desktop and mobile sizes; the root game directory retains its static cards.
  • Current-page semantics, native anchors, a disclosure button, visible keyboard focus and 44-pixel controls make the route chooser usable with keyboard and touch. Escape closes it and restores focus.
  • Navigation stays outside game stages. Separate participant windows retain their existing game-only presentation. Return or close those windows before changing the operator page.
  • Read-only viewer blockers retain active, pending, release-unconfirmed and unknown ownership. A cancelled Start stays pending through its late acknowledgement and scoped cleanup. Failed release leaves the existing Retry controls available. Browser camera identification is included.
  • A cancelable app-local departure event lets the separate floor-calibration repair contribute its source ownership state. Game engines, session behavior, vision, model configuration and camera transport are unchanged.

Acquisition ownership follow-up

Combined review found that the initial navigation barrier still allowed another Start after local Stop while its first response remained pending. Mole and Dodgeball now share the pending/unknown barrier across direct acquisition guards and camera/source controls, and refresh ownership status after every startup finally path. A returned epoch is retained before handling a fast worker error. Round configuration locks remain intact. Runner/calibration source is untouched.

Synthetic real-server evidence against 3ff148718fa062843c56774d329fffdffb4a5c88: each desktop/mobile game previously sent two Start requests in Start → Stop → forced Start; the corrected version sends one until acknowledged cleanup. All 4 game/viewport combinations passed failed late release, acknowledged retry, explicit replacement after cleanup and missing-epoch restart guidance, with zero uncaught errors. 12 after screenshots accompany four before screenshots. No camera or vision service ran. Eighteen added unit regressions also cover lost/invalid-JSON/null responses, repeated Stop, explicit rejection, error-with-epoch release and disposal.

Keyboard and honest recovery

Cross-set integration

The independent floor-calibration repair (#60) adds another source owner on Maze. This PR verifies a calibration-style veto through motion-studio:navigation-check, a cancelable bubbling event on #app, with detail.reason. The calibration controller must keep its veto active through pending/active/release-failed/unknown states. If combining viewer return objects, preserve both calibration and participant-window blockers with a null-coalescing combination. The unmerged controller itself was not exercised here; combined verification belongs to campaign integration.

Limits and remaining physical evidence

  • Application-link guards preserve the owner page. Browser Back, address-bar changes, tab close and OS shutdown still rely on existing best-effort unload cleanup. Modified/new-tab links leave the owner open and keep ordinary browser behavior.
  • No camera, participant footage or private device identifier was used. Physical driver release, camera/GPU performance, input latency, model accuracy and physical calibration were not measured. This is software navigation evidence.
  • Changing pages ends in-memory rounds/settings. There is no cross-page session transfer. Live calibration remains unavailable in this baseline; the two-camera link opens existing planning and synthetic rehearsal.
  • Local checks use Node 24.16.0; hosted CI pins Node 24.21.0. Only English is supported. Screenshots cover 1440×1000 and 390×844; report layout is separately inspected at 1440, 390 and 320 pixels.

Owning guide: docs/operator-navigation.md. Reproduce with node scripts/verify-operator-navigation.mjs --baseline, node scripts/verify-operator-navigation.mjs, node scripts/operator-navigation-report.mjs and node scripts/verify-operator-navigation.mjs --report-only. Use the shared serialized wrapper on the campaign machine. No external media or script is required to read this report offline.
